title: Nimble Vinegar Kenyan Sour Fritters
description: Sour, crumbly, and adventurous Kenyan dish featuring pickle juice and caramelized onions. Perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together gluten-free flour, kosher salt, and crushed pink peppercorns.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, grated carrot, grated ginger, and chopped cilantro.
Add the pickle juice to the egg mixture and whisk until combined.
Add the dry ingredients to the egg mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Heat 1-2 inches of oil in a fondue pot over medium heat.
Once the oil is hot, add the dough and cook until it is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Caramelize the onions by heating 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Once the onions are caramelized, set them aside to cool.
Serve the fritters with caramelized onions on top.
